verdict.rationale: Steel's CLI documents its own click/fill/type commands, but nothing shows these act on natural-language described elements or survive selector and layout changes, so they are adjacent rather than the story's capability. The semantic and vision-based action loops come from third-party integrations (Browser-Use, OpenAI/Claude/Gemini Computer Use), and Puppeteer/Playwright/Selenium access is a selector-based building block, so neither earns credit.
